the problem of calculating Feynman integrands with a given topology and a given number of external and internal lines by integration by parts is reduced to the calculation of a certain number of vacuum integrals, and that the number of vacuum diagrams needed for the calculation can be found from the topology of the diagram and the total number of external lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the solution of recurrence relations for 3-loop propagators and 2-loop vertices in the general case, with arbitrary numerator and denominator factors, in the case when the external momenta are on the light-cone.
the problem of solving the recurrence relations for mass-less 2-loop vertex diagrams with arbitrary numerators.
solving recurrence relations for Feyman diagrams with the same total numbers of external and loop momentum.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the problem of finding solutions to recurrence relations for 1 -loop massless propagator diagrams is equivalent to the problem of finding a solution to recurrence relations for the 2 -loop massless vertex diagrams with arbitrary numerator and integer power of propagators.

the solution of the recurrence relation for 2-loop vertex diagrams with arbitrary numerator and integer power of propagator, with two external momenta on the light cone is equivalent to the solution of the corresponding 3-loop vacuum diagrams with arbitrary integer power of propagators.
all massless 2-loop vertex diagrams are expressed in terms of a single master function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the solution of recurrence relations for 3-loop propagators with integer powers of propagator denominators is a key ingredient for the solution of recurrence for arbitrary 2-loop vertex diagrams with arbitrary numerators.
the problem of finding the general solution of the recurrence relations for Feyfman diagrams with arbitrary numerators is reduced to solving the corresponding problem for the propagator diagrams.

the solution of recurrence relations for 1-loop 2-, 3-, 4-point Feynman integrands is known and the same is true for 2-loop vertex integrands with arbitrary numerator and integer powers of the propagators, if two legs are on light cone.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to solve recurrence relations for L-loop R-point Feynman integrs, it suffices to solve the corresponding problem for L+R-loop propagator diagrams.

the problem of finding the solution of recurrence relations for 1-loop massless Feynman integrands with arbitrary numerator terms and powers of propagators can be reduced to the solution of the same problem with the same numerators but with integer powers of propagator.
the method of integration-by-parts can be used to solve the recurrence relations for Feynamn integrals with the total number of external momenta equal to the total number of loop momenta.
